change: Living ink portrait, paper-and-charcoal identity, clearer companion introduction and responsive working screens
preserved: Memory-only session and encrypted file saving
Quick exit and visible session status

implementation.artwork: Original generated ink portrait of a fictional adult, served locally as a transparent 546 KB WebP. Exact prompt and provenance are in ink-artwork.json. No external image requests.
implementation.interaction: Moving points react to the pointer or a tap. Three opening topics explain the available help and preselect a concern while retaining an existing plan. No account is connected or changed.
implementation.motion: Canvas 2D point drawing with flowing strands and a settling/replay animation. Explicit pause/play and replay controls. Rendering stops offscreen and in a hidden tab. Reduced-motion preference defaults to a still drawing with explicit opt-in playback. Frame rate is capped at 30 fps and pixel density at 2; no WebGL dependency.
implementation.workspace: Warm paper, charcoal controls, muted clay accents and locally hosted Fraunces display type. Clear working surfaces, larger headings, compact mobile story choices and visible companion steps.
implementation.disclosure: Try Me remains a scripted example. The companion cannot change accounts. The original transparent artwork is the canvas-failure fallback; the product remains usable when artwork cannot load.

validation.localBrowserRun: All 77 production-build browser tests passed across the full run and one targeted rerun. The full run passed 76; one privacy test still expected the old development port. After replacing that hardcoded string with an exact-origin check against the configured preview URL, the targeted rerun passed. All setup geometry checks passed in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.
checks: Paused drawing stays unchanged and replay restarts motion
Starting controls fit within the viewport
Topic selection and existing concern retention
Plan, file, history and consent regression tests
Manual desktop and mobile-size browser review
Setup geometry at 320, 390, 768 and 1440 px in English and Polish

validation.nativeSafari: Reproduced the 185 px setup column and overlapping action on the live site in native Safari. Verified the corrected production preview: full-width setup, concern and app selection, no overlapping action, and successful continuation into the first guide.

limits: Browser checks do not replace physical-device testing or usability studies with the target audience. Native Safari setup and first-guide navigation were inspected. No new claim about live AI availability is made.
historicalArtwork: Earlier portrait and photograph assets and their provenance files are retained but are no longer used by the opening.

setupLayoutFix.cause: The identity stylesheet overrode the setup single-column rule with the normal two-column workspace grid. With the sidebar hidden, the form occupied the 185 px sidebar track. Its bottom-sticky action overlapped the wrapped content.
setupLayoutFix.correction: An explicit setup modifier owns a single flexible grid column independently of stylesheet load order. The action remains in normal document flow after the questions. Choice columns and controls can shrink without horizontal overflow.
setupLayoutFix.regressionProof: The new WebKit regression failed before the fix with actual setup width 185 px versus a minimum readable desktop width of 760 px.
